# Rule 3.1: Powergaming. Taking actions beyond your character's physical and psychological capabilities. Your character is an ordinary person who feels fear and pain; do not forget that. You also must not hide items “just in case” or bolt doors as a head of department unless your area has already been broken into during the same round. This rule does not apply to major antagonists.
